notes.title: 'The Island: In to the mist' release schedule announce
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591730/10f43b1444ebaa6806a9ae5084249961fda8c8c4.png

Our game, 'The Island: In to the mist, is currently in provision of English localization. 

We are aiming to launch our game during January time frame, along both Korean and 'English' version of it. 
It will include fully translated images and texts in English with some full service catering (*wink wink) of Korean voice lines. 

This was a bold move of ours, hoping more people to enjoy 'The Island: In to the mist' better in English. 

We are looking forward you guys to enjoy our game.(!!)
Thank you.
